channel.title: AERM Research Journal
channel.description: Static research updates generated from markdown files.

item.title: Case Study: Environmental Assessment of an Allegedly Haunted Abandoned School
item.description: An educational case study demonstrating how environmental analysis,systematic observation,and evidence-based methodology can be applied when investigating reports of unusual activity at an abandoned school.

item.title: Conducting Reliable Witness Interviews in Paranormal Investigations: A Structured Evidence-Based Approach
item.description: Learn how professional investigators conduct reliable witness interviews through structured questioning,objective documentation,and evidence-based methodology while minimizing cognitive bias and preserving testimonial integrity.

item.title: Confirmation Bias in Paranormal Investigations: Why Objectivity Matters
item.description: Explore how confirmation bias can influence paranormal investigations,why objective evidence is essential,and how investigators can reduce cognitive bias through structured methodology.

item.title: Environmental Investigation Methodology: An Evidence-Based Research Framework
item.description: Explore AERM's evidence-based methodology for investigating unexplained phenomena through systematic observation,environmental analysis,transparent documentation,and reproducible research practices.

item.title: Environmental Noise and Paranormal Perception: Understanding the Science Behind Unexplained Sounds
item.description: Discover how environmental noise,acoustics,and human perception can influence reports of unexplained sounds,and why systematic audio analysis is essential in evidence-based investigations.

item.title: Environmental Testing in Paranormal Investigations: Understanding the Environment Before Drawing Conclusions
item.description: Learn why environmental testing is a fundamental component of evidence-based paranormal investigations and how scientific analysis of environmental conditions helps investigators evaluate unexplained reports objectively.

item.title: Evidence Analysis in Paranormal Investigations: From Observation to Evidence-Based Conclusions
item.description: Learn how evidence is systematically evaluated during paranormal investigations using objective analysis,environmental context,and critical thinking to produce reliable conclusions.

item.title: Field Safety in Paranormal Investigations: Risk Assessment and Professional Safety Guidelines
item.description: Learn the essential field safety practices for evidence-based paranormal investigations,including risk assessment,environmental hazards,emergency planning,equipment safety,and ethical responsibilities.

item.title: The Role of Forensic Science in Paranormal Investigations: Applying Scientific Principles to Unexplained Reports
item.description: Discover how forensic science principles strengthen paranormal investigations through systematic evidence collection,scene documentation,environmental analysis,and objective evaluation.

item.title: Ghost Hunting Myths vs Evidence: Separating Popular Beliefs from Scientific Investigation
item.description: Explore some of the most common myths surrounding paranormal investigations and compare them with evidence-based investigative practices used by modern research organizations.

item.title: The History of Paranormal Investigation: From Folklore to Scientific Inquiry
item.description: Explore the evolution of paranormal investigation from ancient folklore and spiritual beliefs to modern evidence-based research methodologies and environmental analysis.

item.title: Equipment Reviews in Evidence-Based Investigations: A Scientific Framework for Evaluating Investigation Tools
item.description: Learn how AERM objectively evaluates investigation equipment using scientific criteria including accuracy,reliability,environmental performance,usability,documentation,and operational limitations.

item.title: How to Think Like an Evidence-Based Investigator: A Guide for Beginners
item.description: Learn the mindset and essential principles of evidence-based investigation. This guide explains how professional investigators approach unusual reports using observation,critical thinking,and scientific methodology.

item.title: Introducing the AERM Research Journal: Advancing Evidence-Based Investigation
item.description: AERM officially announces the launch of its Research Journal,a platform dedicated to publishing evidence-based articles,investigation methodologies,environmental studies,case analyses,and educational research.

item.title: Systematic Investigation Methodology for Unexplained Reports: A Structured Evidence-Based Approach
item.description: Learn the structured methodology used in professional investigations to evaluate reports of unexplained phenomena through systematic observation,environmental assessment,evidence collection,and critical analysis.

item.title: Technology in Modern Paranormal Investigations: Enhancing Evidence Through Scientific Innovation
item.description: Explore how modern technology supports evidence-based paranormal investigations through environmental monitoring,digital documentation,data analysis,and objective scientific observation.

item.title: Thermal Imaging in Paranormal Investigations: Understanding Temperature Anomalies Through Scientific Observation
item.description: Discover how thermal imaging cameras assist investigators in documenting temperature variations,identifying environmental influences,and collecting objective evidence during field investigations.

item.title: Understanding EMF Meters in Paranormal Investigations: Principles,Applications,and Limitations
item.description: Learn how EMF meters work,what they actually measure,their role in paranormal investigations,common sources of electromagnetic fields,and why evidence-based interpretation is essential.

item.title: Understanding Lux Meters in Paranormal Investigations: Measuring Light with Scientific Precision
item.description: Learn how Lux meters measure illumination,why they are essential in evidence-based paranormal investigations,common sources of lighting anomalies,and best practices for collecting reliable environmental data.

item.title: What to Expect from an AERM Investigation Workshop: Learning Evidence-Based Paranormal Investigation
item.description: Discover what participants learn during an AERM Investigation Workshop,including scientific methodology,environmental assessment,evidence collection,documentation,and ethical investigation practices.

item.title: Why Evidence Matters More Than Belief: An Editorial on Responsible Investigation
item.description: An editorial exploring why evidence should remain at the center of every investigation and how responsible research depends on curiosity,transparency,and critical thinking rather than belief alone.

item.title: Research Ethics and Transparency in the Investigation of Unexplained Phenomena
item.description: Explore the ethical principles that guide AERM's investigations,emphasizing transparency,evidence-based reporting,responsible communication,and scientific integrity when documenting unexplained phenomena.
